summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Wave 8 Insights Hub consolidation. Backend APIs fully functional (28/29 tests passed). Frontend UI renders correctly with all 5 vertical tabs, 6 KPI tiles, deep Risk & Alerts sections, and role-aware behavior (admin=COMPANY scope with 5 tabs, manager=PERSONAL scope with 4 tabs, Team tab hidden). Sidebar successfully consolidated from 8 entries to 1 'Analytics & Insights' entry. Found 2 legacy URL redirect issues.

backend_issues.notes: One expected 403 error for manager accessing admin-only /api/admin/kpi/dashboard endpoint - this is correct role-based access control, not a bug.

integration_issues.issue: /admin/risk and /admin/journey do NOT redirect to /admin/insights - they still load old standalone pages (RiskDashboardPage, JourneyPage)
